A scroll journey

Into the Deep

From Earth orbit to the edge of the observable universe.

scroll↓

01 · Low Earth Orbit

Earth

Four hundred kilometres up, the atmosphere is a thin blue line. Every story ever told happened underneath it.

02 · Cislunar Space

The Moon

One point three light-seconds out. The last footprints here are half a century old, and the dust holds them still.

03 · The Inner Planets

Mars

Rust-red and patient. Its dust storms can swallow the entire planet for weeks at a time.

04 · 2.7 Astronomical Units

The Asteroid Belt

Leftover rubble from the solar system's construction — millions of worlds too small to be worlds.

05 · The Outer System

The Giants

Jupiter could swallow a thousand Earths. Saturn's rings are ice — at this scale, thinner than a sheet of paper.

06 · Interstellar Space

Stellar Nurseries

Clouds of gas and dust light-years tall, where gravity is quietly assembling the next generation of stars.

07 · The Deep Field

Galaxies

Every smudge of light is a galaxy of its own — hundreds of billions of them. This whole journey covered almost none of it.

Thanks for riding along. Refresh to fall back to Earth.
